analyzed_vuln.description: The PoV triggers an internal compiler abort because SSA/CFG metadata becomes inconsistent during DFA optimization, and the debug integrity checker asserts in ssa_verify_integrity() (ssa_integrity.c:401). Specifically, a basic block ends up with duplicate predecessor entries (the failing check is in ssa_integrity.c around the predecessor-uniqueness validation), which violates SSA invariants and causes ZEND_ASSERT(0). The crash site is ssa_verify_integrity(), but the bug is in the optimization pipeline that mutates CFG/SSA state before verification (invoked from zend_dfa_optimize_op_array()).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Input flows from fuzzer-tracing-jit -> fuzzer_do_request_from_buffer() into PHP compilation with opcache optimizer enabled. A malformed/edge-case PHP script (as in the PoV, with heavily corrupted syntax fragments that still reach optimizer stages) must compile far enough to run DFA/SSA passes. Under ZEND_DEBUG_DFA integrity checks, the optimizer constructs/updates CFG predecessors incorrectly (including duplicate predecessor entries), and the subsequent ssa_verify_integrity() call aborts.

patch_result.failure_reason: the agent did not produce a result

args: In php-src/Zend/Optimizer/dfa_pass.c, identify code paths in DFA/SCCP/DCE/jump optimization that mutate CFG predecessor lists and could introduce duplicate predecessors. Please point to specific functions and snippets where predecessor arrays/counts are updated without deduplication or where edge rewrites can append same predecessor twice.

We have a crash in php-src/Zend/Optimizer/ssa_integrity.c at duplicate predecessor check (around lines 389-392) triggered during zend_dfa_optimize_op_array() in dfa_pass.c. The integrity checker is likely correct and indicates CFG metadata corruption. I inspected dfa_pass.c around zend_dfa_optimize_op_array() and saw it calls sccp_optimize_op_array(), zend_dfa_optimize_jmps(), zend_dfa_optimize_calls(), and dce_optimize_op_array(), with integrity checks after phases under ZEND_DEBUG_DFA. We need root-cause patch in C/C++ code, minimal behavior change. Please analyze where CFG predecessor lists are rebuilt/updated in these passes and whether duplicate insertion is possible when rewriting jumps/successors, especially in malformed scripts that still compile.
